name: Youth Volunteer at Sutter Mills-Peninsula Medical Center
city: Burlingame, CA (1501 Trousdale Drive) and San Mateo, CA (100 South San Mateo Drive)
what_you_do: You help patients of all ages and hospital staff after school, on weekends, or during summer and school breaks. You are interviewed before you start.
who_can_apply: High school students 16 and 17 years old. You need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian and one signed by a teacher.
duration: At least one 3 to 4 hour visit a week, with a one-year minimum commitment
deadline_text: Open for this window: applications and both consent forms are due by 5 PM on Sunday, Nov 15, 2026, for a February 2027 start. Windows run twice a year, May 1 to 15 and November 1 to 15.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form by the deadline, including a 500 to 1,000 word personal statement. Email the signed parent form and teacher form to the office. Both forms are on the page. No Google Drive links, HEIC photos or digital signatures. Then you do an interview, online training and health tests. Questions? Email MPHSvolunteerservices@sutterhealth.org or call 650-696-2465 and press 2.
notes: Read on the official Sutter Health listing and the application form on 2026-11-02. The form says this cohort starts in February 2027 and has three required on-site events: an information meeting for youth and a parent or guardian on Dec 1, 2026, 6 PM to 7 PM; Passport for youth on Feb 1, 2027, 3:30 PM to 5 PM; and orientation for youth on Feb 9, 2027, 4:30 PM to 7:30 PM. If you cannot make all three, you are asked to apply for a later cohort. Health testing is required but the listing does not list which shots or tests.
